description: EXCHANGE: a one-time nonce + the exact message to sign locally, bound to ONE intended action (ADR 0024). Pass op: 'post' (with type + bounty), 'claim'|'submit'|'accept'|'reject'|'cancel' (with taskId), or 'profile'. The message spells out the action ('COINOP task:claim:<taskId>:<wallet>:<nonce>') — a signature for one action cannot be replayed for another. Every Exchange mutation takes a FRESH nonce issued for that exact action; nonces are single-use, 5-minute life.
name: coinop_tasks_nonce
